concepts.quote: args[1] crashes at run time because Ann is args[0]
concepts.why: Correctly relates the typed argument to index 0 and the out-of-range args[1] to a run-time crash for this given failing case (locating the mistake in the given code is L3, not L4).

concepts.quote: Two compile errors first ... After that it compiles, but args[1] crashes at run time
concepts.why: Correctly orders compile-time errors (file name, missing ;) before any run and distinguishes them from the run-time failure that only appears once compilation succeeds.
